text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I couldn't sleep a wink
after
getting into bed last night...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They say that stressing about falling
asleep just makes it worse, so I just laid
on my side and tried
not to worry about
it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But I was still wide awake when the sun came up... Maybe I should've tried harder to fall asleep? Yaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Hishi Akebono had a pretty
restless
night...
